hook.name: UMiner
hook.description: A combined ERC-20 token (uLEGIT) and Uniswap v4 hook that charges a configurable ETH tax (initially 20%, capped at 30%) on both buys and sells, forwarding proceeds to a hardcoded treasury address. Buy swaps that include a recipient address in hookData mint pseudo-NFT "Miner" badges with hashpower proportional to ETH spent; each swap's volume bleeds virtual fees distributed to miners proportionally.
